message.content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pairs a large language model with an external knowledge store, retrieving relevant passages at query time. Those passages are concatenated into the prompt so the model grounds its answer in fresh, source-of-truth data rather than only its training corpus. The result is a system that can cite, update, and constrain its outputs without retraining the underlying model.
